name: proxmox-writing-style
description: Unofficial skill for the Proxmox Technical Writing Style Guide. Use it to write, edit, or review Proxmox documentation: Proxmox VE, Proxmox Backup Server, and Proxmox Mail Gateway admin guides, wiki pages, how-to guides, procedures, release notes, and UI text. Also use it when the user asks for the Proxmox style, the Proxmox wiki style, or a style review of Proxmox text. It covers voice, mood, sentence length, procedures, headings, punctuation, product names, terms, abbreviations, and examples.
